title: Quiz — Chapter 3.5: Graphing Linear Equations in Slope-Intercept Form

questions.feedbackIfWrong: A line that falls from left to right has a negative slope.
hints: Think of going downhill.
The y-values decrease as x increases.
questions.prompt: What is the slope of a line that falls from left to right?
The slope of a horizontal line is ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The slope of a horizontal line is 0.
hints: There is no vertical change.
Rise is 0.

questions.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (4, 20) and (7, 14).

hints: It is the point where the line crosses the vertical axis.
It is the constant term.
questions.prompt: In the slope-intercept form y = mx + b, what does b represent?
The equation y = 8 is an example of a ___ function.
hints: Its graph is a horizontal line.
The slope is 0.
Add 5x to both sides, then divide by -1.
The constant term in y = -5x + 2 is the y-intercept.
questions.prompt: Rewrite -5x - y = -2 in slope-intercept form. What is the y-intercept?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The equation becomes y = -5x + 2, so the y-intercept is 2.

hints: Undefined slope occurs when the run is zero.
A vertical line has undefined slope.
questions.prompt: Which line has an undefined slope?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: x = -3 is a vertical line, so its slope is undefined.

hints: Slope is m, y-intercept is b.
Plug m = 3 and b = -2 into y = mx + b.
questions.prompt: A line has slope 3 and passes through (0, -2). Write the equation in slope-intercept form. (e.g., y=3x-2)
To graph y = -2x + 5, what is the first point you plot?
hints: The y-intercept is the starting point.
b = 5, so the line crosses the y-axis at (0,5).
Slope = rise/run.
The denominator of the slope is the run.
questions.prompt: If a line has slope -3/4, from any point on the line you can move down 3 units and right ___ units to find another point.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: The slope 650 means the submersible ascends at 650 feet per minute.
questions.prompt: A submersible's elevation is h(t) = 650t - 13,000. What does the slope 650 represent?
hints: Slope is the coefficient of t.
It tells how fast the elevation changes per minute.
Set h(t) = 0 and solve for t.
questions.prompt: In h(t) = 650t - 13,000, how long until the submersible reaches the surface? (in minutes)

hints: Substitute x = 100.
questions.prompt: The cost to rent a truck is c(x) = 0.5x + 70. What is the cost for 100 miles?

hints: The slope is the rate of change.
1/2 inch per hour.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The snow depth increases by 0.5 inch per hour.
questions.prompt: The graph of the function d(t) = 1/2 t + 6 represents snow depth. The slope 1/2 means the snow depth increases by ___ inch(es) per hour.

hints: A slope of 0 means a horizontal line.
Look for an equation with no x-term.
questions.prompt: Which equation represents a line with slope 0?
